title: CBirkbeck/uniform-sheafy-tate-domains-lean
summary: A Lean 4 formalisation of *Uniform sheafy Tate rings that are not stably uniform* (Birkbeck–Torzewski), answering Question 7 of Kedlaya's *Nonarchimedean Scottish Book* in the negative: a sheafy uniform Huber pair need not be stably uniform. Buzzard–Verberkmoes and Mihara proved that stably uniform Tate Huber rings are sheafy; whether the converse holds was open. The paper gives two complete Tate algebras over a complete discretely valued field `k` that are uniform, nonnoetherian integral domains with `A° = A₀`, strongly sheafy (every Tate algebra `A⟨X₁, …, Xₙ⟩` is sheafy), and yet not…
